title: The Cosmic Body and Its Five Watch-Stations
description: An opening paradox: how can the unchanging great God be bound in the smallness of the body? The answer unfolds the whole cosmos as a great captive man (Error's counter-likeness) — head as firmaments, navel as zodiac-sphere, skin as fire-wall, organs as natural creatures — within which the Lord has stationed five divine guardians at their watch-stations: Pherokatochos (mind), King of Honor (thought), Adamas of Light (teaching), King of Glory (counsel), Omophoros (reflection).
